name: Russia–NATO
value: Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec
summary: Estonia will close its Russian border crossings on 1 Dec after a GRU-ordered sabotage plot; no Article 4 request
state: Estonia said on 15 Nov it will close its road border crossings with Russia from 1 Dec after a foiled 14 Nov attack on drone maker Threod Systems that it says Russia's GRU commissioned (Al Jazeera). Tallinn summoned Russia's chargé d'affaires over the plot (LIGA.net). No Article 4 request, military clash or attack on NATO territory was found as of 18 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Travellers to the Baltic states should check FCDO travel advice and expect changes at Estonia's Russian border crossings from 1 Dec.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to Russia = Watch; no Article 4 or clash

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Estonia to close border crossings with Russia after attack on drone maker
LIGA.net — Estonia summoned the Russian chargé d'affaires over an attempted sabotage

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
